description: This file defines the OverlayPanelFactory enum with static methods to create, animate, present, and dismiss overlay panels and windows in a macOS application using AppKit. It centralizes panel creation and animation logic.

methods.name: makePanel
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSPanel with specified visual properties and behavior flags.

methods.name: animatePresent
methods.description: Animates a window from a starting rectangle to a target rectangle with fade-in effect.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Animates the window's frame to a specified rectangle with easing.

methods.name: applyFrame
methods.description: Sets the window's frame to a target rectangle, optionally with animation.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles presenting the window either with an animation on first display or instantly if already visible.

methods.name: animateDismiss
methods.description: Animates window dismissal by moving and fading out, then calls a completion handler.

methods.name: animateDismissAndHide
methods.description: Animates window dismissal and hides it, then executes a callback.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventMonitor
methods.description: Removes a global event monitor if it exists.
